meaning: n. 大混乱, 混沌;混沌; 浑沌

examples.en: The sudden blackout caused chaos in the whole building.
examples.zh: 突然停电让整栋大楼陷入混乱。

meaning: vt. 废止, 革除, 消灭;废除, 取消, 裁撤

examples.en: The city plans to abolish all parking fees downtown.
examples.zh: 该市计划取消市中心的全部停车费。

meaning: n. 天文学家

examples.en: The astronomer studies the stars with a huge telescope.
examples.zh: 天文学家用巨大的望远镜研究星星。

meaning: a. 可怕的, 遭透的, 极讨厌的

examples.en: The traffic was horrible this morning, so I was late.
examples.zh: 今天早上堵车太糟糕了,所以我迟到了。

meaning: adv. 分开, 不相连, 分隔, 分离, 不同, 单独, 独立, 各自, 各别, 脱离肉体, 灵魂;分离地

examples.en: Please wrap the two gifts separately for the party.
examples.zh: 聚会的两份礼物请分开包装。

meaning: a. 细致优雅的, 微妙的, 美味的;柔弱的

examples.en: Be careful with that delicate glass vase on the table.
examples.zh: 小心桌上那个易碎的玻璃花瓶。

meaning: n. 钩, 钩状, 镰刀, 陷阱;vt. 挂...于钩上, 钩住, 引上钩, 偷窃

examples.en: Hang your coat on the hook behind the door.
examples.zh: 把外套挂在门后的挂钩上。

meaning: n. 旅行者, 游客, 旅客, 旅行推销员, 活动起重架, 行车, 临时记帐单

examples.en: The tired traveler asked the way to the nearest inn.
examples.zh: 疲惫的旅行者打听去最近旅店的路。

meaning: a. 钝的, 无趣的, 呆滞的, 阴暗的;vt. 使迟钝, 使阴暗, 缓和

examples.en: The film was so dull that I fell asleep twice.
examples.zh: 这部电影很无聊,我睡着了两次。

meaning: n. 腹部, 食欲;vt. 使鼓起

examples.en: The baby laughed and patted his round belly after eating.
examples.zh: 宝宝吃饱后拍着圆鼓鼓的肚子笑了。

meaning: n. 惊吓, 恐慌;vt. 惊吓, 使恐慌

examples.en: The horror movie didn't scare my sister at all.
examples.zh: 这部恐怖片根本没吓到我妹妹。

meaning: v. 提供饮食及服务, 投合, 迎合

examples.en: This small restaurant caters for weddings and birthday parties.
examples.zh: 这家小餐馆承办婚礼和生日宴会。

meaning: n. 穿梭, 梭子, 往返移动之物;v. (使)穿梭移动, 往返运送

examples.en: A free shuttle bus runs between the airport and hotel.
examples.zh: 机场和酒店之间有免费班车。

meaning: n. 援救, 解救, 营救;vt. 援救, 救出, 营救

examples.en: The team rescues lost hikers in these mountains.
examples.zh: 这支队伍在这些山区营救迷路的徒步者。

meaning: adv. 幸福地, 快乐地, 幸好

examples.en: The children played happily in the garden all afternoon.
examples.zh: 孩子们整个下午在花园里开心地玩。

meaning: n. 旅馆, 客栈;vi. 住旅馆

examples.en: We stayed at a quiet inn by the lake.
examples.zh: 我们住在湖边一家安静的旅店。

meaning: n. 训练员, 驯马师;列车器

examples.en: Her personal trainer helps her exercise three times a week.
examples.zh: 她的私人教练帮她每周锻炼三次。

meaning: a. 垂直的, 直立的;垂直的, 顶的, 头顶的

examples.en: The vertical lines on the wall make the room look taller.
examples.zh: 墙上的竖线条让房间看起来更高。

meaning: n. 想象力, 幻想, 喜好;a. 想象的, 精美的, 新奇的, 奇特的, 高价的, 特级的

examples.en: She wore a fancy dress to her cousin's wedding.
examples.zh: 她穿了条漂亮的裙子参加表姐的婚礼。

meaning: n. 光线, 射线, 闪烁, 光辉;vi. 射出光线, 浮现, 放射光线

examples.en: A single ray of sunshine came through the clouds.
examples.zh: 一缕阳光穿透云层洒了下来。

meaning: n. 平行, 对比, 相匹敌之物;a. 平行的, 相似的

examples.en: The railway runs parallel to the old coast road.
examples.zh: 铁路与老海岸公路平行延伸。

meaning: n. 释放, 解放;发出; 释放; 放出

examples.en: The museum tells the story of the city's liberation.
examples.zh: 博物馆讲述了这座城市解放的故事。

meaning: n. 拳头, 手;vt. 拳打, 握成拳, 紧握

examples.en: She raised her fist in excitement when her team scored.
examples.zh: 球队进球时,她兴奋地挥舞拳头。

meaning: n. 激光;激光器

examples.en: Our teacher uses a laser pointer during science lessons.
examples.zh: 老师在科学课上使用激光笔。

meaning: n. 失望

examples.en: Losing the match was a big disappointment for the whole team.
examples.zh: 输掉比赛让全队都很失望。

meaning: a. 凶猛的, 猛烈的, 热烈的, 暴躁的

examples.en: A fierce wind shook the tents during our mountain camp.
examples.zh: 猛烈的大风摇晃着我们露营的帐篷。

meaning: n. 苦难, 受苦

examples.en: Doctors work hard to reduce the suffering of their patients.
examples.zh: 医生努力减轻病人的痛苦。

meaning: n. 钻石, 菱形;菱形

examples.en: Grandma's diamond ring shines brightly in the sunlight.
examples.zh: 奶奶的钻戒在阳光下闪闪发光。

meaning: a. 光亮的, 了不起的, 灿烂的, 壮丽的, 显著的, 杰出的

examples.en: We had a splendid view of the mountains from the tower.
examples.zh: 从塔上我们看到壮丽的山景。

meaning: n. 精确, 正确;准确度

examples.en: A good reporter always checks facts for accuracy.
examples.zh: 好记者总是核实事实确保准确。

meaning: n. 表演者, 执行者, 完成者;执行者, 履行者, 实行者

examples.en: The street performer juggled five balls at once.
examples.zh: 街头艺人同时抛接五个球。

meaning: n. 希腊

examples.en: My parents spent their honeymoon in Greece many years ago.
examples.zh: 我父母多年前在希腊度蜜月。

meaning: n. 环境;a. 周围的

examples.en: The town is famous for its quiet surrounding countryside.
examples.zh: 这座小镇以宁静的乡村环境闻名。

meaning: n. 把握, 抓紧, 理解, 抓, 柄, 控制;vt. 抓住, 紧握, 领会

examples.en: I grasped her hand as we crossed the busy street.
examples.zh: 过繁忙的马路时我紧紧抓住她的手。

meaning: n. 品脱(干量或液量的单位);量磅, 品脱

examples.en: Dad ordered a pint of cold beer after work.
examples.zh: 爸爸下班后点了一品脱冰啤酒。

meaning: a. 动态的, 有活力的, 有力的, 动力的, 不断变化的;n. 动力, 动态

examples.en: Our new English teacher is lively and dynamic in class.
examples.zh: 我们的新英语老师课堂上活泼又有活力。

meaning: n. 翻译, 译文, 转化, 调任, 平移, 转译;转换

examples.en: She is reading a Chinese translation of a French novel.
examples.zh: 她在读一本法国小说的中文译本。

meaning: n. 纪念物, 请愿书;a. 记念的, 记忆的

examples.en: People lay flowers at the war memorial every spring.
examples.zh: 每年春天人们向战争纪念碑献花。

meaning: a. 宝贵的, 珍贵的, 过于精致的, 珍爱的

examples.en: Time with family is the most precious gift of all.
examples.zh: 与家人相处的时光是最珍贵的礼物。

meaning: a. 被强制的, 强迫的, 义务的;强迫的, 强制的

examples.en: Wearing a helmet is compulsory when you ride a motorcycle.
examples.zh: 骑摩托车必须戴头盔。

meaning: n. 颚, 颌;v. 闲谈, 教训, 唠叨

examples.en: He broke his jaw in the football game last week.
examples.zh: 他上周在足球比赛中摔断了下巴。

meaning: n. 出租车, 出租汽车, 出租马车;vi. 乘出租马车(或汽车)

examples.en: We took a cab to the airport early this morning.
examples.zh: 今天一早我们打车去了机场。

meaning: n. 原始人, 早期艺术家;a. 原始的, 上古的

examples.en: People in primitive times made tools from stone and wood.
examples.zh: 远古时期人们用石头和木头制作工具。

meaning: n. 社会主义, 社会主义运动

examples.en: We discussed socialism in our history class today.
examples.zh: 今天历史课上我们讨论了社会主义。

meaning: a. 有系统的, 分类上的, 体系的;系统的, 系的, 分类的

examples.en: She keeps a systematic record of every book she reads.
examples.zh: 她系统地记录自己读过的每一本书。

meaning: n. 希腊人, 希腊语;a. 希腊的, 希腊人的

examples.en: My cousin is learning to cook Greek food this summer.
examples.zh: 我表哥今年夏天在学做希腊菜。

meaning: n. 总理, 首相;a. 首位的, 最初的

examples.en: The premier visited our city and spoke with local farmers.
examples.zh: 总理访问了我们的城市,并与当地农民交谈。

meaning: n. 牺牲, 供奉, 祭品;vt. 牺牲, 祭祀, 贱卖

examples.en: Parents often sacrifice their own time for their children.
examples.zh: 父母常常为孩子牺牲自己的时间。

meaning: a. 不幸的, 不合适的, 不吉利的

examples.en: It is unfortunate that the concert was canceled because of rain.
examples.zh: 不幸的是,音乐会因雨取消了。

meaning: a. 笨拙的, 棘手的

examples.en: I felt awkward when I forgot my teacher's name.
examples.zh: 忘记老师名字时我感到很尴尬。

meaning: n. 东北;a. 东北的, 向东北的, 来自东北的

examples.en: The birds fly northeast when autumn comes each year.
examples.zh: 每年秋天来临时,鸟儿向东北方向飞。

meaning: n. 水浅的地方, 浅滩;a. 浅的, 肤浅的

examples.en: The children swam safely in the shallow end of the pool.
examples.zh: 孩子们在游泳池的浅水区安全地游泳。

meaning: n. 箭, 箭状物, 箭头记号

examples.en: The hunter's arrow hit the target right in the center.
examples.zh: 猎人的箭正中靶心。

meaning: n. 电冰箱, 冷藏库;冷冻机; 致冷器

examples.en: Put the milk back in the refrigerator, please.
examples.zh: 请把牛奶放回冰箱。

meaning: n. 笼, 牢房, 战俘营;vt. 关进笼内

examples.en: The bird sang happily inside its large cage.
examples.zh: 鸟在大笼子里快乐地歌唱。

meaning: n. 监护人, 管理人, 看守人;保管人, 看守人, 保持片

examples.en: The zoo keeper feeds the pandas fresh bamboo every morning.
examples.zh: 饲养员每天早上给熊猫喂新鲜竹子。

meaning: n. 本国, 故国

examples.en: After twenty years abroad, he returned to his homeland.
examples.zh: 在国外二十年后,他回到了祖国。

meaning: vt. 祝福, 祈佑, 使神圣化

examples.en: Grandma blesses our food before every family dinner.
examples.zh: 每次家宴前奶奶都要为食物祈福。

meaning: a. 易接近的, 可进入的, 可使用的, 易受影响的, 可理解的

examples.en: The new library is accessible to people in wheelchairs.
examples.zh: 新图书馆对轮椅使用者无障碍开放。

meaning: vt. 分类, 归类, 分等;分类, 分级, 分粒

examples.en: Scientists classify animals into many different groups.
examples.zh: 科学家把动物分成许多不同的类别。

meaning: n. 袖子, 套管;vt. 缝上袖子

examples.en: He rolled up his sleeves and helped wash the dishes.
examples.zh: 他挽起袖子帮忙洗碗。

meaning: n. 墨西哥

examples.en: My uncle moved to Mexico City for work last year.
examples.zh: 我叔叔去年搬去墨西哥城工作。

meaning: n. 珠宝, 珠宝类

examples.en: She keeps her jewelry in a small wooden box.
examples.zh: 她把首饰放在一个小木盒里。

meaning: adv. 然后, 后来

examples.en: We had dinner and went to a movie afterward.
examples.zh: 我们吃了晚饭,之后去看了一场电影。

meaning: n. 大理石, 石弹, 雕刻品;a. 大理石的, 冷酷无情的, 有大理石花纹的

examples.en: The kitchen floor is made of cool white marble.
examples.zh: 厨房地板由凉爽的白色大理石制成。

meaning: n. 胜任, 职称, 能力;能力, 活性

examples.en: Her competence in English helped her get the new job.
examples.zh: 她的英语能力帮她得到了这份新工作。

meaning: n. 衣领, 颈圈;vt. 控制, 扭住衣领, 给...装上领子

examples.en: The dog's collar has a small bell on it.
examples.zh: 狗的项圈上挂着一个小铃铛。

meaning: n. 跑步者, 赛跑者, 送信人, 走私船, 操作者, 滑槽;碾碎机; 压碎机

examples.en: The lead runner tripped just before the finish line.
examples.zh: 领跑的选手在终点线前摔倒了。

meaning: n. 原子, 核能, 微粒, 微量;原子

examples.en: Scientists split the atom to produce huge energy.
examples.zh: 科学家分裂原子以产生巨大能量。

meaning: a. 值得花时间的, 值得做的, 有真实价值的

examples.en: Volunteering at the shelter is a worthwhile weekend activity.
examples.zh: 在收容所做志愿活动是有意义的周末活动。

meaning: a. 含糊的, 不清楚的, 茫然的

examples.en: His directions were so vague that we got lost.
examples.zh: 他的指路太含糊,我们迷路了。

meaning: n. 鼓励, 激励, 奖励;怂恿, 煽动, 助长

examples.en: Her teacher's encouragement gave her confidence to speak in public.
examples.zh: 老师的鼓励给了她当众发言的信心。

meaning: n. 餐后甜点

examples.en: What would you like for dessert, cake or ice cream?
examples.zh: 甜点你想要蛋糕还是冰淇淋?

meaning: n. 两星期

examples.en: We stayed with our grandparents for a fortnight this summer.
examples.zh: 今年夏天我们和祖父母一起待了两周。

meaning: n. 亭, 摊棚;货摊, 电话间

examples.en: They took family photos in a small booth at the fair.
examples.zh: 他们在集市的照相亭拍了全家福。

meaning: vt. 宽容, 容许, 有耐力

examples.en: The teacher will not tolerate cheating in any exam.
examples.zh: 老师绝不容忍任何考试作弊。

meaning: n. 瑞士

examples.en: Switzerland is famous for its beautiful mountains and fine watches.
examples.zh: 瑞士以美丽的山脉和精美的手表闻名。

meaning: n. 悬挂, 暂停, 中止;悬浮; 悬浮体; 悬浮液

examples.en: We walked across the famous suspension bridge over the river.
examples.zh: 我们走过了河上那座著名的吊桥。

meaning: n. 盆, 盆地;第三脑室, 骨盆

examples.en: She washed her hands in the basin before dinner.
examples.zh: 晚饭前她在脸盆里洗了手。

meaning: n. 仁慈, 善良

examples.en: Oh my goodness, look at all this wonderful food!
examples.zh: 天哪,看看这些丰盛的美食!

meaning: a. 相似的, 同样的;adv. 一样, 以同样的方式

examples.en: The twin sisters dress alike and even laugh alike.
examples.zh: 双胞胎姐妹穿着相似,笑声也相似。

meaning: n. 闲逛, 休闲室, 长沙发;vi. 闲混, (懒洋洋地)躺

examples.en: The students chatted in the lounge between classes.
examples.zh: 学生们课间在休息室聊天。

meaning: n. 边界, 边境;国境, 边境, 边界

examples.en: Settlers once built small homes along the western frontier.
examples.zh: 拓荒者曾在西部边境沿线建造小屋。

meaning: n. 水沫, 浪花, 水花, 喷雾, 喷雾器, 小树枝;vt. 喷雾, 扫射, 喷射

examples.en: Dad used a spray to keep the insects off the plants.
examples.zh: 爸爸用喷雾剂防止植物生虫。

meaning: n. 观光业, 游览;旅游业

examples.en: Tourism brings many visitors to our town every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天旅游业给小镇带来许多游客。

meaning: n. 畜生, 动物, 野兽, 兽性

examples.en: The beast in the movie looked scary but was actually kind.
examples.zh: 电影里的野兽看起来吓人,其实很善良。

meaning: n. 利益, 方面

examples.en: He signed the contract on behalf of his company.
examples.zh: 他代表公司签了合同。

meaning: a. 全世界的

examples.en: Her song became popular worldwide within just a few weeks.
examples.zh: 她的歌曲几周内就风靡全球。

meaning: a. 狂热的, 热心的, 热烈的

examples.en: The students were enthusiastic about the coming science trip.
examples.zh: 学生们对即将到来的科学之旅充满热情。

meaning: a. 移动的, 易变的, 机动的;n. 活动物体

examples.en: She left her mobile phone on the school bus again.
examples.zh: 她又把手机落在校车上了。

meaning: a. 坚硬的, 刚性的, 严格的, 精密的, 刻板的

examples.en: The old school had very rigid rules about uniform.
examples.zh: 那所老学校对校服有非常死板的规定。

meaning: v. (使)流通, (使)循环, (使)传播

examples.en: Open the window so fresh air can circulate through the room.
examples.zh: 打开窗户,让新鲜空气在房间里流通。

meaning: n. 轮胎;vt. 装轮胎于

examples.en: Dad changed the flat tyre before we drove to work.
examples.zh: 爸爸开车上班前换掉了瘪掉的车胎。

meaning: vi. 淹死;vt. 把...淹死, 淹没

examples.en: A boy nearly drowned in the lake yesterday afternoon.
examples.zh: 昨天下午一个男孩差点在湖里溺水。

meaning: n. 比利时

examples.en: My cousin is studying French in Belgium this year.
examples.zh: 我表姐今年在比利时学习法语。

meaning: a. 消极的, 被动的, 冷漠的, 顺从的, 无源的;被动的

examples.en: He takes a passive attitude toward his homework every day.
examples.zh: 他每天对作业都持消极态度。

meaning: n. 侵犯, 侵略;攻击

examples.en: The dog showed no aggression toward the visiting children.
examples.zh: 这只狗对来访的孩子没有表现出攻击性。

meaning: n. 装饰, 装饰品

examples.en: The classroom decoration took us almost two hours.
examples.zh: 教室的装饰花了我们近两个小时。

meaning: n. 重击, 突然巨响, 刘海;v. 发巨响, 重击

examples.en: I heard a loud bang from the kitchen downstairs.
examples.zh: 我听到楼下厨房传来一声巨响。

meaning: n. 奴隶的身分, 奴隶状态, 奴隶制度;奴隶制度, 奴役, 苦役

examples.en: The museum tells the history of slavery in America.
examples.zh: 这座博物馆讲述了美国奴隶制的历史。

meaning: a. 有益的, 受益的;有使用权的, 可享利益的

examples.en: Eating vegetables regularly is beneficial to your health.
examples.zh: 经常吃蔬菜对你的健康有益。

meaning: n. 饥饿, 渴望, 饥荒;vt. 使挨饿

examples.en: Millions of children still suffer from hunger every day.
examples.zh: 每天仍有数百万儿童忍受饥饿。

meaning: n. 抓痕, 搔, 抓, 擦伤, 刮擦声, 乱写, 零分, 起跑线;vt. 搔, 抓, 挖出, 擦, 刮, 乱涂, 勾抹掉

examples.en: Do not scratch the insect bite, or it will get worse.
examples.zh: 别抓蚊子咬的包,不然会更严重。

meaning: n. 图书馆员, 图书管理员;程序库管理程序; 程序库生成程序

examples.en: The librarian helped me find a book about stars.
examples.zh: 图书管理员帮我找了一本关于星星的书。

meaning: n. 细菌;杆菌属

examples.en: A single bacterium can multiply very quickly in warm food.
examples.zh: 一个细菌在温热的食物里能迅速繁殖。

meaning: n. 二氧化物;二氧化物

examples.en: Plants take in carbon dioxide and release fresh oxygen.
examples.zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳并释放新鲜氧气。

meaning: n. 杰出人物;a. 有价值的, 可敬的, 值得的

examples.en: Her brave act is worthy of our deepest respect.
examples.zh: 她的勇敢行为值得我们深深的敬意。

meaning: n. 协调, 和睦, 调和;和声学

examples.en: The two roommates live together in perfect harmony.
examples.zh: 两个室友非常和谐地住在一起。

meaning: a. 幸运的, 幸福的

examples.en: We were fortunate to catch the last bus home.
examples.zh: 我们很幸运赶上了末班公交车回家。

meaning: n. 诱惑, 诱惑物;诱惑, 诱惑物

examples.en: He resisted the temptation to check his phone in class.
examples.zh: 他抵住了上课看手机的诱惑。

meaning: n. 看护, 养育;护理, 喂乳

examples.en: She is nursing the baby while her husband cooks dinner.
examples.zh: 她在照料宝宝,丈夫在做晚饭。

meaning: n. 小心, 慎重, 警示;vt. 警告

examples.en: You should use caution when crossing the busy street.
examples.zh: 过繁忙的马路时你应该小心谨慎。

meaning: a. 使人不愉快的, 使人厌恶的, 煞风景的

examples.en: The fish gave off an unpleasant smell in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 鱼在厨房里散发出一股难闻的气味。

meaning: n. 管理人, 招待员, 管家, 乘务员;轮船, 飞机的服务员, (财务)管理员

examples.en: The steward served drinks to passengers on the plane.
examples.zh: 飞机上的乘务员给乘客端来饮料。

meaning: a. 相反的, 矛盾的, 对立的;n. 相反, 对立面

examples.en: On the contrary, I think the movie was quite boring.
examples.zh: 恰恰相反,我觉得这部电影相当无聊。

meaning: n. 拱门, 拱形, 足弓;vt. 使成弓形

examples.en: An old stone arch stands at the entrance of the park.
examples.zh: 一座古老的石拱门立在公园入口处。

meaning: n. 印刷, 印刷术, 印花;打印; 印刷

examples.en: The printing of the exam papers takes about an hour.
examples.zh: 打印试卷大约需要一个小时。

meaning: n. 贵族;a. 高贵的, 高尚的, 贵族的, 辉煌的

examples.en: Helping strangers is a noble thing to do.
examples.zh: 帮助陌生人是一件高尚的事。

meaning: a. 引起烦恼的, 令人不安的

examples.en: The news report about the flood was deeply disturbing.
examples.zh: 关于洪水的新闻报道令人非常不安。

meaning: n. 间谍, 侦探, 侦察;vt. 侦察, 找出, 发现

examples.en: The spy hid the secret papers inside his shoe.
examples.zh: 间谍把秘密文件藏在鞋子里。

meaning: n. 传记

examples.en: I am reading a biography of a famous scientist.
examples.zh: 我在读一位著名科学家的传记。

meaning: n. 方便, 便利的事物, 方便的时候

examples.en: The hotel offers the convenience of a twenty-four-hour restaurant.
examples.zh: 酒店提供二十四小时餐厅的便利。

meaning: v. 加速, 促进

examples.en: The car began to accelerate as the light turned green.
examples.zh: 绿灯亮起,汽车开始加速。

meaning: a. 全国性的;全国的, 全国范围的

examples.en: The new traffic rules will take effect nationwide next month.
examples.zh: 新交通规则下个月将在全国生效。

meaning: n. 嫌恶;vt. 讨厌, 不喜欢

examples.en: Many kids dislike eating bitter melon because of its taste.
examples.zh: 许多孩子因为味道而不喜欢吃苦瓜。

meaning: n. 疾病, 不健康, 呕吐;病

examples.en: A sudden sickness kept her in bed all weekend.
examples.zh: 突如其来的疾病让她整周末都躺在床上。

meaning: a. 喜欢的, 宠爱的, 温柔的

examples.en: My grandmother is very fond of old black-and-white films.
examples.zh: 我奶奶非常喜欢老的黑白电影。

meaning: n. 抽烟, 冒烟;烟熏; 吸烟

examples.en: Smoking is not allowed anywhere inside the train station.
examples.zh: 火车站内任何地方都禁止吸烟。

meaning: n. 电报, 电报机;vi. 打电报

examples.en: In the past, people sent urgent messages by telegraph.
examples.zh: 过去人们用电报发送紧急消息。

meaning: adv. 在船上, 在火车上, 在飞机上;prep. 在...之上

examples.en: All the passengers climbed aboard the ship before it departed.
examples.zh: 所有乘客在开船前都登上了船。

meaning: n. 仁慈, 宽恕, 慈悲, 怜悯, 幸运;权宜处置权, 决定权, 宽恕

examples.en: The judge showed mercy to the young first-time offender.
examples.zh: 法官对年轻的初犯者表现出了仁慈。

meaning: n. 虫, 蠕虫, 小人物, 螺纹, 蜗杆;vi. 蠕行, 慢慢前进

examples.en: The little boy watched a worm crawl across the sidewalk.
examples.zh: 小男孩看着一条虫子爬过人行道。

meaning: a. 很可能的, 大概的, 可信的;n. 很有希望的候选人, 很可能的事情

examples.en: It is probable that the meeting will end early today.
examples.zh: 今天会议很可能提前结束。

meaning: n. 疤痕, 伤痕, 悬崖;vi. 结疤, 愈合, 痊愈

examples.en: He has a small scar on his left knee.
examples.zh: 他左膝上有一个小伤疤。

meaning: a. 未意识到的, 无意识的, 无知觉的;人事不省的, 神志丧失的; 无意识的

examples.en: The player lay unconscious on the field after the collision.
examples.zh: 碰撞后那名球员躺在球场上失去了知觉。

meaning: vt. 使惊吓;vi. 惊恐

examples.en: The strange noise in the attic may frighten the children.
examples.zh: 阁楼里的怪声可能会吓到孩子们。

meaning: n. 牛仔, 牛郎, 牧童

examples.en: The cowboy rode his horse across the wide open plain.
examples.zh: 牛仔骑着马穿过宽阔的平原。

meaning: a. 内陆的, 国内的;n. 内地

examples.en: They moved inland to escape the crowded coastal cities.
examples.zh: 他们搬到内陆以避开拥挤的沿海城市。

meaning: n. 哭, 哭泣;vi. 哭泣, 流泪, 哀悼, 滴落

examples.en: She began to weep when she heard the sad news.
examples.zh: 听到这个悲伤的消息,她哭了起来。

meaning: n. 少女, 未婚女子, 女仆

examples.en: The maid cleaned the hotel room before the guests arrived.
examples.zh: 服务员在客人到达前打扫了酒店房间。

meaning: adv. 向后地, 相反地;a. 向后的, 相反的

examples.en: He stepped backward to let the old woman pass first.
examples.zh: 他后退一步,让老太太先过。

meaning: vt. 窒息, 阻塞, 噎, 抑制;vi. 窒息, 阻塞, 噎

examples.en: Be careful not to choke on the small fish bones.
examples.zh: 小心别被细小的鱼刺卡住喉咙。

meaning: n. 豌豆, 似豌豆的东西

examples.en: My sister planted a pea seed in a small pot.
examples.zh: 我妹妹在一个小花盆里种了一粒豌豆种子。

meaning: a. 机密的, 获他人信赖的, 易于信任他人的;秘密件

examples.en: Please keep this confidential document locked in the office safe.
examples.zh: 请把这份机密文件锁在办公室保险柜里。

meaning: n. 白昼, 日光;vt. 使沐浴于日光

examples.en: The robbery happened in broad daylight on a busy street.
examples.zh: 抢劫发生在繁忙街道的大白天。

meaning: a. 灰尘多的, 无聊的, 含糊的, 粉末状的

examples.en: The old bookshelf in the attic is quite dusty.
examples.zh: 阁楼上的旧书架落满了灰尘。

meaning: adv. 真诚地

examples.en: I sincerely hope you can join us for the party.
examples.zh: 我真诚地希望你能来参加我们的聚会。

meaning: n. 兴味, 娱乐, 消遣;娱乐, 娱乐活动

examples.en: The kids shouted with amusement when the clown fell down.
examples.zh: 小丑摔倒时,孩子们开心地大笑。

meaning: n. 香草, 香子兰

examples.en: She ordered a large scoop of vanilla ice cream.
examples.zh: 她点了一大勺香草冰淇淋。

meaning: vt. 保险, 确保;vi. 投保

examples.en: You should insure your new bicycle against theft.
examples.zh: 你应该给你的新自行车上防盗保险。

meaning: n. 大陆, 本土;大陆

examples.en: They took a ferry from the island to the mainland.
examples.zh: 他们乘渡轮从岛上去了大陆。

meaning: n. 烤架, 铁格子, 烤肉;v. 烧, 烤, 严加盘问, 给...装栅栏

examples.en: Dad likes to grill beef and corn on summer weekends.
examples.zh: 爸爸喜欢在夏天的周末烤牛肉和玉米。

meaning: adv. 高声地, 大声地, 吵闹地

examples.en: The baby cried loudly when the thunder started outside.
examples.zh: 外面打雷时,婴儿大声哭了起来。

meaning: a. 可携带的, 可搬运的, 可移动的;可移植的

examples.en: I bought a portable speaker for our camping trip.
examples.zh: 我为露营之旅买了一个便携式音箱。

meaning: n. 以鼻吸气, 嗅, 气息;vi. 嗅, 蔑视, 嗤之以鼻

examples.en: The dog began to sniff the ground near the gate.
examples.zh: 狗开始在大门附近嗅地面。

meaning: n. 东京;东京

examples.en: My uncle has lived in Tokyo for almost ten years.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在东京住了将近十年。

meaning: a. 自治的;自主的

examples.en: The region became autonomous and now makes its own laws.
examples.zh: 这个地区获得了自治,现在制定自己的法律。

meaning: n. 闪耀光, 刺眼;vi. 发眩光, 瞪视

examples.en: She gave him an angry glare when he arrived late.
examples.zh: 他迟到时,她愤怒地瞪了他一眼。

meaning: n. 埃及人;a. 埃及的, 埃及人的

examples.en: The Egyptian pyramids attract millions of tourists every year.
examples.zh: 埃及金字塔每年吸引数百万游客。

meaning: n. 调制解调器;调制解调器

examples.en: Restart the modem if the internet connection suddenly drops.
examples.zh: 如果网络突然断开,就重启调制解调器。

meaning: n. 经常开支, 普通用费, 天花板;a. 在头上的, 高架的

examples.en: A flock of birds flew overhead as we picnicked.
examples.zh: 我们野餐时,一群鸟从头顶飞过。

meaning: a. 生动的, 鲜明的, 鲜艳的, 活泼的, 逼真的, 清晰的

examples.en: The writer used vivid colors to describe the sunset.
examples.zh: 这位作家用生动的色彩描写日落。

meaning: n. 劳动者, 干体力工作的工人, 劳工;劳动者

examples.en: The labourer carried heavy boxes up the steep stairs.
examples.zh: 工人扛着沉重的箱子爬上陡峭的楼梯。

meaning: n. 物理学家, 机械唯物论者, 自然科学家;菲西克氏手术(虹膜圆片切除)

examples.en: The physicist explained black holes in a simple way.
examples.zh: 这位物理学家用简单的方式解释了黑洞。

meaning: n. 售货员, 推销员;售货员, 店员, 推销员

examples.en: The salesman showed us three different models of vacuum cleaners.
examples.zh: 推销员给我们展示了三种不同型号的吸尘器。

meaning: n. 铝;a. 铝的

examples.en: The window frame is made of light and strong aluminium.
examples.zh: 窗框由轻而坚固的铝制成。

meaning: a. 不愿意的, 勉强的;不愿意的, 勉强的, 不服从的

examples.en: He was unwilling to share his toys with his cousin.
examples.zh: 他不愿意和表弟分享玩具。

meaning: n. 堆, 许多, 累积;vt. 堆积, 装满

examples.en: A heap of dirty clothes lay on his bedroom floor.
examples.zh: 他卧室地板上堆着一堆脏衣服。

meaning: a. 油炸的

examples.en: Mom prepared fried eggs and toast for breakfast this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上妈妈准备了煎蛋和吐司当早餐。

meaning: n. 直译程序, 解释者, 口译者, 注释器;注释器

examples.en: The interpreter translated the speech into three different languages.
examples.zh: 口译员把演讲翻译成三种不同的语言。

meaning: n. 碰撞, 冲突, 抵触;冲突

examples.en: The fog caused a collision between two trucks on the highway.
examples.zh: 大雾导致高速公路上两辆卡车相撞。

meaning: n. 冲撞, 破折号, 短跑;vi. 猛冲, 冲撞

examples.en: He had to dash to catch the morning train.
examples.zh: 他不得不飞奔去赶早班火车。

meaning: a. 不成功的

examples.en: After several unsuccessful attempts, she finally passed the driving test.
examples.zh: 经过几次失败的尝试,她终于通过了驾照考试。

meaning: a. 荒谬的, 不合理的, 可笑的;n. 荒诞

examples.en: It sounds absurd, but my cat is afraid of cucumbers.
examples.zh: 听起来很荒谬,但我的猫怕黄瓜。

meaning: a. 可选择的, 随意的;选购的

examples.en: The evening class is optional, so you can choose freely.
examples.zh: 晚上的课是选修的,所以你可以自由选择。

meaning: n. 雪茄

examples.en: The old man lit a cigar after finishing his dinner.
examples.zh: 老人吃完晚饭后点了一支雪茄。

meaning: n. 娱乐, 消遣, 休息, 再创造;娱乐, 休养

examples.en: Swimming is my favorite form of recreation in summer.
examples.zh: 游泳是我夏天最喜欢的娱乐方式。

meaning: n. 航行, 航海术, 启航;a. 航行的

examples.en: We went sailing on the lake last Saturday morning.
examples.zh: 上周六早上我们去湖上扬帆游玩。

meaning: n. 瑞士人, 瑞士腔调;a. 瑞士的, 瑞士风格的

examples.en: She bought a Swiss watch as a gift for her father.
examples.zh: 她买了一块瑞士手表作为送给父亲的礼物。

meaning: n. 传真;vt. 发传真

examples.en: Please fax the signed contract back to our office today.
examples.zh: 请今天把签好的合同传真回我们办公室。

meaning: n. 美颜, 脸部按摩;a. 脸的, 表面的, 脸部用的

examples.en: The hotel spa offers a relaxing facial treatment for guests.
examples.zh: 酒店水疗中心为客人提供放松的面部护理。

meaning: n. 主妇, 家庭妇女

examples.en: My neighbor is a busy housewife with three young children.
examples.zh: 我的邻居是一位带着三个小孩的忙碌家庭主妇。

meaning: n. 共产主义

examples.en: The professor gave a lecture on communism and its history.
examples.zh: 教授做了一场关于共产主义及其历史的讲座。

meaning: n. 污染, 污点, 着色剂;vt. 沾染, 染污, 着色

examples.en: The coffee stain on my white shirt will not come out.
examples.zh: 我白衬衫上的咖啡渍怎么也洗不掉。

meaning: n. 修面, 刮胡子, 幸免, 剃刀;vt. 修面, 剃, 修剪, 掠过

examples.en: Dad forgot to shave this morning and looked quite scruffy.
examples.zh: 爸爸今天早上忘记刮胡子,看起来很邋遢。

meaning: n. 啤酒厂, 酿酒厂;酿造所

examples.en: The small town is famous for its old beer brewery.
examples.zh: 这个小镇以古老的啤酒厂而闻名。

meaning: num. 第十六, 十六分之一

examples.en: Her birthday falls on the sixteenth of next month.
examples.zh: 她的生日在下个月十六号。

meaning: a. 有害的, 伤害的

examples.en: Too much screen time can be harmful to young eyes.
examples.zh: 屏幕时间过长对年轻人的眼睛有害。

meaning: vt. 使恐惧, 恐吓

examples.en: Thunderstorms terrify the little dog, so we comfort her gently.
examples.zh: 雷雨吓坏了小狗,所以我们轻声安抚它。

meaning: a. 透明的, 显然的, 清晰的;透明

examples.en: The transparent water bottle shows how much you have drunk.
examples.zh: 透明的水瓶能显示你喝了多少水。

meaning: n. 叙述, 话, 说, 言论

examples.en: There is an old saying that practice makes perfect.
examples.zh: 俗话说,熟能生巧。

meaning: n. 复活节

examples.en: The children painted colorful eggs for Easter this year.
examples.zh: 今年孩子们为复活节彩绘了彩蛋。

meaning: n. 领导者, 指挥者, 售票员, 向导;导体

examples.en: The conductor checked every ticket before the train departed.
examples.zh: 列车员在火车开动前查验了每张车票。

meaning: pron. 无论那一个, 任何一个

examples.en: Choose whichever flavor you like; they are all fresh.
examples.zh: 喜欢哪种口味就选哪种,都很新鲜。

meaning: a. 冰冻的, 冷冻用的, 严寒的;冻结; 冻结作用; 凝固; 凝固作用

examples.en: It is freezing outside, so wear your warm coat.
examples.zh: 外面冷得要命,所以穿上暖和的外套。

meaning: n. 晴朗, 光明正大, 美丽;公正, 适当

examples.en: The referee was praised for his fairness during the match.
examples.zh: 裁判因比赛中的公正而受到称赞。

meaning: n. 以货易货;v. 交换, 替换, 交易

examples.en: Let's swap seats so you can sit by the window.
examples.zh: 我们换换座位吧,这样你能坐在窗边。

meaning: n. 订正, 改正, 改正的地方;校正

examples.en: The teacher made a quick correction to my last sentence.
examples.zh: 老师对我写的最后一句做了快速订正。

meaning: n. 滴答声, 一瞬间, 壁虱, 褥套, 信用, 赊欠;vi. 滴答响, 活动

examples.en: I could hear the clock tick in the quiet room.
examples.zh: 安静的房间里我能听到时钟滴答作响。

meaning: n. 褐雨燕, 快速爬行的小蜥蜴, 蝙蝠蛾, 大滚筒;a. 迅速的, 快的, 敏捷的, 立刻的

examples.en: Her swift reaction saved the little girl from falling.
examples.zh: 她敏捷的反应救了小女孩,没让她摔倒。

meaning: a. 可从中得到乐趣的, 令人愉快的

examples.en: Our trip to the countryside was truly enjoyable and relaxing.
examples.zh: 我们的乡村之行非常愉快和放松。

meaning: n. 地窖, 地下室, 藏酒

examples.en: The farmer stores his wine in a cool cellar underground.
examples.zh: 农民把酒存放在地下凉爽的酒窖里。

meaning: a. 难以置信的

examples.en: It is unbelievable that she finished the marathon in three hours.
examples.zh: 她三小时就跑完了马拉松,真难以置信。

meaning: n. 珠宝, 贵重物, 镶珠宝的饰物;vt. 饰以珠宝, 镶以宝石

examples.en: The queen wore a shining jewel on her golden crown.
examples.zh: 王后在金皇冠上戴着一颗闪亮的宝石。

meaning: a. 官僚的;机僚化的

examples.en: The bureaucratic process took months before we got our permit.
examples.zh: 繁琐的官僚流程花了好几个月我们才拿到许可。

meaning: n. 刻度盘, 钟面, 转盘;v. 拨

examples.en: Dial the emergency number if the fire gets out of control.
examples.zh: 如果火势失控,就拨打紧急电话。

meaning: n. 熏猪肉;腌肉

examples.en: I fried some bacon and eggs for a quick breakfast.
examples.zh: 我煎了些培根和鸡蛋当快捷早餐。

meaning: n. 芥末, 芥菜, 强烈的兴趣;芥子; 芥属植物

examples.en: He added a little mustard to his sandwich for extra flavor.
examples.zh: 他在三明治里加了一点芥末提味。

meaning: n. 村民

examples.en: Every villager helped build the new bridge across the river.
examples.zh: 每位村民都帮忙修建了跨河的新桥。

meaning: a. 北极的, 极寒的;n. 北极圈, 北极

examples.en: Polar bears survive the cold Arctic winter with thick fur.
examples.zh: 北极熊靠厚厚的皮毛度过寒冷的北极冬天。

meaning: n. 幼稚园

examples.en: My little brother just started kindergarten this September.
examples.zh: 我弟弟今年九月刚上幼儿园。

meaning: n. 棉被;vt. 加软衬料后缝制, 东拼西凑地编

examples.en: Grandma made a warm quilt for my winter bed.
examples.zh: 奶奶为我的冬床缝了一床温暖的被子。

meaning: n. 单身汉, 学士;学士, 单身汉

examples.en: He lives as a bachelor in a small city apartment.
examples.zh: 他单身,住在城里的一间小公寓里。

meaning: n. 高速公路

examples.en: The freeway was jammed with cars during rush hour.
examples.zh: 高峰时段高速公路上堵满了汽车。

meaning: a. 向上的;adv. 以上

examples.en: The balloon drifted upward until it disappeared behind the clouds.
examples.zh: 气球向上飘去,直到消失在云层后面。

meaning: n. 滚筒, 滚轴, 压路机;滚柱; 托辊

examples.en: The kids laughed loudly on the roller coaster at the fair.
examples.zh: 游乐场上,孩子们坐在过山车上大声欢笑。

meaning: a. 大量的, 充足的, 丰富的

examples.en: The hotel room has ample space for a family of four.
examples.zh: 这间酒店客房对四口之家来说空间充足。

meaning: a. 引起敬畏的, 可怕的

examples.en: The view from the mountain top was totally awesome.
examples.zh: 山顶的景色真是太棒了。

meaning: vt. 预见, 预知

examples.en: Nobody could foresee the sudden change in the weather.
examples.zh: 没人能预料到天气的突然变化。

meaning: a. 空的, 空白的, 空虚的, 空闲的, 茫然的, 空缺的;空的, 空虚的, 闲暇的

examples.en: The vacant house next door has been empty for years.
examples.zh: 隔壁的空房子已经空置多年了。

meaning: n. 高度, 海拔, 高处;高度

examples.en: The plane flies at an altitude of ten thousand meters.
examples.zh: 飞机在一万米的高度飞行。

meaning: n. 手电筒, 闪光信号灯

examples.en: Take a flashlight because the path gets dark after sunset.
examples.zh: 带上手电筒,日落后小路会很黑。

meaning: n. 郊游, 远足;a. 远足适用的

examples.en: Our class planned an outing to the natural history museum.
examples.zh: 我们班计划去自然历史博物馆郊游。

meaning: a. 无希望的, 绝望的, 不可救药的

examples.en: He felt hopeless after failing the exam for the third time.
examples.zh: 第三次考试失利后,他感到很绝望。

meaning: n. 女侍者, 女服务员

examples.en: The friendly waitress brought us menus and two glasses of water.
examples.zh: 友好的女服务员给我们拿来菜单和两杯水。

meaning: n. 飞机;飞机

examples.en: The aeroplane landed safely despite the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 尽管下着大雨,飞机还是安全降落了。

meaning: n. 摔跤, 角力, 扭斗;vi. 摔跤, 搏斗, 斗争, 斟酌

examples.en: The brothers like to wrestle on the living room carpet.
examples.zh: 兄弟俩喜欢在客厅地毯上摔跤玩。

meaning: vt. 解开, 取消, 破坏, 毁灭, 扰乱;vi. 松开

examples.en: Press this button to undo your last change.
examples.zh: 按这个按钮可以撤销上一次的修改。

meaning: a. 怀疑论的, 怀疑的

examples.en: I was sceptical about the magic trick until I saw it.
examples.zh: 在亲眼看到之前,我一直对那个魔术表示怀疑。

meaning: a. 惯常的, 习惯了的

examples.en: She quickly became accustomed to the cold winters in Canada.
examples.zh: 她很快习惯了加拿大寒冷的冬天。

meaning: a. 不明确的, 模棱两可的;意思含糊的, 模棱两可的, 暧昧的

examples.en: His answer was ambiguous, so nobody understood his real plan.
examples.zh: 他的回答含糊不清,没人明白他的真实计划。

meaning: n. 热爱, 投入

examples.en: Her devotion to her students made her a beloved teacher.
examples.zh: 她对学生的奉献使她成为受人爱戴的老师。

meaning: n. 天文学

examples.en: My brother studies astronomy and dreams of walking on Mars.
examples.zh: 我哥哥学天文学,梦想着去火星上行走。

meaning: n. 人类, 男性

examples.en: The invention of electricity changed mankind in countless ways.
examples.zh: 电的发明以无数种方式改变了人类。

meaning: a. 泥泞的, 浑浊的, 模糊的;vt. 使污浊, 使沾上泥污

examples.en: Our shoes got muddy after hiking on the rainy trail.
examples.zh: 在雨后的小径上徒步后,我们的鞋沾满了泥。

meaning: n. 山坡, 山腹

examples.en: Sheep grazed quietly on the green hillside above the village.
examples.zh: 羊群在村庄上方的绿色山坡上安静吃草。

meaning: n. 航行, 航海, 航程, 旅行, 航空;vi. 航海, 航行

examples.en: The ship began its long voyage across the Pacific Ocean.
examples.zh: 轮船开始了跨越太平洋的漫长航行。

meaning: n. 长袜;马足水肿; 长袜

examples.en: She hung a red stocking by the fireplace on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 平安夜她在壁炉边挂了一只红袜子。

meaning: n. 法国人

examples.en: The Frenchman greeted us warmly in fluent English.
examples.zh: 那个法国人用流利的英语热情地招呼我们。

meaning: n. 内衣

examples.en: Remember to pack enough warm underwear for the winter trip.
examples.zh: 记得为冬日旅行带够保暖的内衣。

meaning: n. 干草;vt. 制干草, 供给干草

examples.en: The horses in the barn were feeding on fresh hay.
examples.zh: 马厩里的马正在吃新鲜的干草。

meaning: n. 平房

examples.en: My grandparents live in a small bungalow near the sea.
examples.zh: 我的祖父母住在海边的一座小平房里。

meaning: a. 令人厌恶的

examples.en: The overflowing trash bin gave off a disgusting smell.
examples.zh: 溢出的垃圾桶散发出恶心的气味。

meaning: n. 同志, 伙伴

examples.en: The old soldier still remembers his comrades from the war.
examples.zh: 老兵仍然记得战争岁月里的战友们。

meaning: a. 反常的, 不规则的, 变态的, 畸形的;n. 畸形的人

examples.en: The doctors noticed some abnormal results in her blood test.
examples.zh: 医生注意到她的血液检查中有异常结果。

meaning: n. 花瓶, 瓶

examples.en: She put a bunch of fresh roses in the blue vase.
examples.zh: 她把一束新鲜玫瑰插进蓝色的花瓶里。

meaning: adv. 向旁边, 向侧面地;a. 旁边的, 向侧面的

examples.en: The gate was narrow, so we slid sideways through it.
examples.zh: 门很窄,所以我们侧着身子挤了过去。

meaning: n. 宽松的上衣

examples.en: She bought a silk blouse for the job interview.
examples.zh: 她为工作面试买了一件丝绸衬衫。

meaning: n. 书店

examples.en: There is a small bookshop around the corner of our school.
examples.zh: 我们学校拐角处有一家小书店。

meaning: n. 香水, 香气, (悦人的)气氛, 美名;vt. 洒香水于, 薰香, 使充满香气

examples.en: The perfume she wore smelled like fresh spring flowers.
examples.zh: 她用的香水闻起来像春天的鲜花。

meaning: n. 令人讨厌之物, 有害之物, 害虫, 瘟疫;鼠疫, 瘟疫

examples.en: Farmers use nets to keep this pest away from crops.
examples.zh: 农民用网来防止这种害虫靠近庄稼。

meaning: n. 超过重量, 过重, 优势;a. 超过重量的, 超重的

examples.en: The doctor told him he was slightly overweight last month.
examples.zh: 医生上个月告诉他他有点超重。

meaning: a. 口头讲的, 口语的;speak的过去分词

examples.en: Her spoken English improved a lot after living abroad.
examples.zh: 在国外生活后,她的英语口语进步很大。

meaning: n. 吸烟者, 吸烟的人, 吸烟车厢, (美)(非正式)蒸汽火车头

examples.en: My uncle, a heavy smoker, is trying hard to quit.
examples.zh: 我叔叔是个老烟民,正在努力戒烟。

meaning: n. 大灾难, 大祸;突变

examples.en: The earthquake was a catastrophe that destroyed the whole town.
examples.zh: 那场地震是一场毁掉整个小镇的灾难。

meaning: a. 有学问的, 学术上的;learn的过去式和过去分词

examples.en: My grandfather is a learned man who reads every evening.
examples.zh: 我祖父是个博学的人,每天晚上都读书。

meaning: n. 背心, 汗背心;vt. 使穿衣服, 授予

examples.en: He wore a bright safety vest while cycling at night.
examples.zh: 他晚上骑车时穿着明亮的安全背心。

meaning: n. 手帕, 头巾, 围巾

examples.en: She wiped her tears with a soft cotton handkerchief.
examples.zh: 她用柔软的棉手帕擦去眼泪。

meaning: a. 放射性的, 有放射能的;放射性的, 放射的

examples.en: The scientists stored the radioactive materials in thick lead boxes.
examples.zh: 科学家们把放射性物质存放在厚铅盒里。

meaning: v. 哀悼, 忧伤, 服丧

examples.en: Thousands gathered to mourn the loss of the great writer.
examples.zh: 数千人聚集哀悼这位伟大作家的离世。

meaning: n. 百万富翁, 大富豪;大资本家, 巨富, 百万富翁

examples.en: He became a millionaire before he turned thirty years old.
examples.zh: 他三十岁之前就成了百万富翁。

meaning: n. 一条面包, 块, 游荡;v. 游手好闲, 虚度光阴

examples.en: Mom bought a fresh loaf of bread from the bakery.
examples.zh: 妈妈从面包店买了一条新鲜的面包。

meaning: n. 母猪, 懒胖女人;vt. 播种, 散布, 使密布

examples.en: Farmers sow the seeds in spring and harvest in autumn.
examples.zh: 农民春天播种,秋天收获。

meaning: n. 灌溉, 冲洗;冲洗法, 灌溉

examples.en: The new irrigation system brings river water to dry fields.
examples.zh: 新的灌溉系统把河水引到干旱的田地里。

meaning: a. 无害处的, 未受损害的, 无辜的, 无恶意的;无害的, 无恶意的, 无损害的

examples.en: The snake in the garden is harmless to humans.
examples.zh: 花园里的那条蛇对人类无害。

meaning: n. 洗脸盆, 厕所

examples.en: The lavatory on the train was small but very clean.
examples.zh: 火车上的厕所很小但很干净。

meaning: a. 反驳的, 反对的, 抗辩的;n. 矛盾因素, 对立物

examples.en: The two witnesses gave contradictory accounts of the same accident.
examples.zh: 两名目击者对同一事故的说法相互矛盾。

meaning: n. 尼龙;尼龙; 聚酰胺纤维

examples.en: The tent is made of light and waterproof nylon.
examples.zh: 帐篷由轻便防水的尼龙制成。

meaning: vt. 使困窘, 使局促不安, 阻碍

examples.en: I did not mean to embarrass you in front of classmates.
examples.zh: 我不是故意在同学面前让你难堪的。

meaning: n. 髭, 小胡子, 触须

examples.en: The detective has a thick moustache and a small pipe.
examples.zh: 侦探留着浓密的小胡子,叼着小烟斗。

meaning: n. 蜡, 蜡状物, 一阵发怒, 增加, (月亮)渐盈;vi. 变大, 增大, 月亮渐满

examples.en: She lit a wax candle when the power went out.
examples.zh: 停电时她点燃了一支蜡烛。

meaning: vi. 啜泣, 呜咽;vt. 哭诉, 哭得使

examples.en: The child began to sob after losing his favorite toy.
examples.zh: 孩子丢了心爱的玩具后呜呜地哭了。

meaning: n. 法郎

examples.en: Before the euro, people in France used the franc.
examples.zh: 在欧元出现之前,法国人使用法郎。

meaning: n. 船员, 海员, 水兵;海员, 水手, 精通海事者

examples.en: The old seaman told stories about storms at sea.
examples.zh: 老水手讲述了海上风暴的故事。

meaning: n. 小鸡, 小鸟, 竹帘

examples.en: The little chick followed its mother around the farmyard.
examples.zh: 小鸡跟着鸡妈妈在农院里走来走去。

meaning: n. 行李;行李

examples.en: Passengers should collect their baggage at carousel number three.
examples.zh: 乘客应在三号行李转盘提取行李。

meaning: n. 摩擦, 摩擦治疗, 不和;摩擦

examples.en: Friction between the two wheels slows the bicycle down.
examples.zh: 两个轮子之间的摩擦会使自行车减速。

meaning: a. 海面的, 吹向海面的, 近海的;adv. 向海面

examples.en: The company drills for oil offshore in deep waters.
examples.zh: 这家公司在深水海域进行海上石油钻探。

meaning: vi. 用正餐, 进餐;vt. 宴请

examples.en: We decided to dine at a small Italian restaurant tonight.
examples.zh: 我们决定今晚在一家小意大利餐馆用餐。

meaning: n. 孵化, 舱口;vt. 孵, 孵出, 策划

examples.en: The eggs will hatch into chicks in about three weeks.
examples.zh: 这些蛋大约三周后就会孵出小鸡。

meaning: n. 剃刀;vt. 剃

examples.en: He left his razor and toothbrush on the bathroom shelf.
examples.zh: 他把剃须刀和牙刷留在了浴室的架子上。

meaning: v. (使)饿死, (使)挨饿

examples.en: Without food and water, the lost climbers could starve within days.
examples.zh: 没有食物和水,迷路的登山者几天内就会挨饿。

meaning: n. 微电脑, 微机;微型计算机; 微计算机

examples.en: The course teaches students how a microcomputer processes data.
examples.zh: 这门课教学生微型计算机如何处理数据。

meaning: vt. 解放, 释放, 使自由;释出, 放出

examples.en: The army fought to liberate the city from enemy control.
examples.zh: 军队为把城市从敌人控制下解放出来而战。

meaning: 铸造

examples.en: The library keeps letters written by the founding teachers of our school.
examples.zh: 图书馆保存着学校创校老师们的信件。

meaning: n. 事先查看, 预览;vt. 事先查看, 预演

examples.en: We watched a short preview of the new movie online.
examples.zh: 我们在网上看了新电影的简短预告片。

meaning: vt. 沐浴, 用水洗;vi. 洗澡

examples.en: The doctor told him to bathe the wound twice daily.
examples.zh: 医生让他每天清洗伤口两次。

meaning: n. 户外, 野外活动;adv. 在户外, 在野外

examples.en: Children love playing outdoors after school on sunny days.
examples.zh: 晴天放学后,孩子们喜欢在户外玩耍。

meaning: n. 文摘;vi. 消化

examples.en: Some foods take longer for your stomach to digest.
examples.zh: 有些食物胃需要更长时间才能消化。

meaning: n. 正午, 中午;a. 正午的

examples.en: We stopped for a sandwich at midday during the hike.
examples.zh: 徒步到中午时,我们停下来吃了个三明治。

meaning: a. 未开化的, 野蛮的, 无礼的, 残酷的, 原始的, 粗鲁的, 未开发的;vt. 用暴力对付, 凶猛攻击

examples.en: The savage storm knocked down trees all over the town.
examples.zh: 猛烈的风暴吹倒了镇上无数的树木。

meaning: vt. 重写, 改写, 改写新闻, 书面答复;vi. 修改旧作

examples.en: The teacher asked me to rewrite the essay more carefully.
examples.zh: 老师让我更认真地重写这篇作文。

meaning: a. 未婚的, 单身的;未婚的, 独身的

examples.en: My aunt is unmarried and enjoys traveling around the world.
examples.zh: 我姑姑未婚,喜欢环游世界。

meaning: n. 打字机

examples.en: My grandfather still writes letters on his old typewriter.
examples.zh: 我祖父仍然用那台旧打字机写信。

meaning: vt. 使恼怒, 骚扰

examples.en: Loud chewing sounds really annoy me during dinner.
examples.zh: 吃饭时大声咀嚼的声音真让我心烦。

meaning: n. 酒鬼, 酒精中毒者;a. 酒精的

examples.en: He gave up alcoholic drinks after the doctor's warning.
examples.zh: 医生警告之后,他戒掉了酒精饮料。

meaning: n. 开...的人, 开局人, 开创人, 开具, 开启工具, 首项;申请开证人

examples.en: Use this opener to remove the lids from the jars.
examples.zh: 用这个开罐器打开罐子的盖子。

meaning: n. 探险家, 探测者, 勘探器;探察器

examples.en: The explorer crossed the desert with only a camel.
examples.zh: 探险家只带着一头骆驼穿越了沙漠。

meaning: n. 手指甲

examples.en: She painted each fingernail a different bright color.
examples.zh: 她把每个指甲都涂成了不同的亮色。

meaning: a. 立方体的, 立方的;立方的, 立方体的

examples.en: The tank holds about two cubic meters of water.
examples.zh: 这个水箱大约能装两立方米的水。

meaning: n. 自助餐, 小卖部, 碗橱, 殴打, 冲击;vt. 连续打, 冲击, 搏斗

examples.en: The hotel offers a breakfast buffet with fresh fruit.
examples.zh: 这家酒店提供带新鲜水果的自助早餐。

meaning: n. 裁缝, 成衣匠;vt. 缝制, 制作, 使适应

examples.en: The tailor measured my shoulders before making the suit.
examples.zh: 裁缝在做西装前量了我的肩宽。

meaning: n. 胡桃;胡桃木

examples.en: Add some walnut pieces to make the salad crunchier.
examples.zh: 加一些核桃仁,让沙拉吃起来更脆。

meaning: n. 公鸡, 雄禽, 龙头, 头目, 锥形小干草堆;vt. 使耸立, 使竖起, 堆成锥形小干草堆

examples.en: The cock crowed loudly at the break of dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分,公鸡大声啼叫。

meaning: n. 坦克手, 油船, 空中加油飞机, 运油飞机, 油槽/水槽汽车;槽车; 油槽船

examples.en: A huge oil tanker arrived at the port this morning.
examples.zh: 一艘巨大的油轮今天早上抵达了港口。

meaning: n. 面包店

examples.en: The smell of fresh bread filled the little bakery.
examples.zh: 新鲜面包的香味充满了这家小面包店。

meaning: n. 吉普车;vi. 乘吉普车

examples.en: We rented a jeep to explore the rocky desert roads.
examples.zh: 我们租了一辆吉普车去探索崎岖的沙漠道路。

meaning: vt. 使失望

examples.en: I promised myself not to disappoint my parents again.
examples.zh: 我向自己保证不再让父母失望。

meaning: n. 钢琴家, 钢琴演奏者

examples.en: The young pianist played beautifully at the school concert.
examples.zh: 年轻的钢琴家在学校音乐会上演奏得很动人。

meaning: a. 向下的

examples.en: The path leads downward to a quiet mountain lake.
examples.zh: 小路向下延伸,通向一个安静的山中湖泊。

meaning: a. 无瑕疵的, 不锈的;不绣的, 污染的

examples.en: Mom prefers stainless knives because they never get rusty.
examples.zh: 妈妈更喜欢不锈钢刀具,因为它们不会生锈。

meaning: n. 评论者, 书评作者, 评论家, 剧评家, 报刊评论家

examples.en: The reviewer praised the film's story but criticized its ending.
examples.zh: 影评人称赞了电影的剧情,却批评了结局。

meaning: vt. 误解, 误会

examples.en: Please do not misunderstand; I only want to help you.
examples.zh: 请别误会,我只是想帮帮你。

meaning: n. 矛, 枪, 持矛者, 嫩枝;vt. 用矛刺

examples.en: Ancient hunters used a sharp spear to catch fish.
examples.zh: 古代猎人用锋利的长矛捕鱼。

meaning: n. 驿马, 替班, 中继, 接力;vt. 分程传递, 转播, 使接替

examples.en: The students ran the relay race at the sports meeting.
examples.zh: 学生们在运动会上跑了接力赛。

meaning: n. 轻推, 轻撞, 慢跑;v. 轻推, (使)蹒跚行进, (使)慢跑

examples.en: Many people jog along the river before work.
examples.zh: 很多人上班前沿着河边慢跑。

meaning: n. 嗥叫, 吠声, 号叫;vi. 狂吠, 咆哮, 呼啸

examples.en: Wolves howl at the moon on cold winter nights.
examples.zh: 寒冷的冬夜里,狼对着月亮嚎叫。

meaning: adv. 自动地, 欣然地

examples.en: She willingly offered her seat to the elderly man.
examples.zh: 她主动把座位让给了那位老人。

meaning: n. 零售商, 店主, 老板

examples.en: The friendly shopkeeper gave the children free candy samples.
examples.zh: 友好的店主给孩子们免费的糖果试吃。

meaning: n. 联合抵制;vt. 联合抵制

examples.en: Customers decided to boycott the store because of high prices.
examples.zh: 顾客决定抵制那家店,因为价格太高。

meaning: a. 可钦佩的, 极好的, 令人惊奇的

examples.en: Her patience with naughty students is truly admirable.
examples.zh: 她对调皮学生的耐心真令人钦佩。

meaning: a. 突然的, 唐突的, 陡峭的, 不连贯的

examples.en: The bus came to an abrupt stop at the red light.
examples.zh: 公交车在红灯前猛地停了下来。

meaning: vi. 颤抖, 地震;n. 颤抖, 地震

examples.en: The quake shook the buildings for almost thirty seconds.
examples.zh: 地震使建筑物摇晃了近三十秒。

meaning: n. 饥饿, 饿死;绝食, 饥锇(指长时期的)

examples.en: Proper food storage saved the village from starvation that winter.
examples.zh: 妥善的食物储存让村庄那年冬天免于饥荒。

meaning: a. 向外的, 表面的, 外服的;adv. 向外, 在外, 表面

examples.en: Her calm outward appearance hid her nervousness inside.
examples.zh: 她外表平静,内心却很紧张。

meaning: vt. 使吃惊

examples.en: The magic tricks never fail to amaze the young audience.
examples.zh: 魔术总能令小观众们惊叹不已。

meaning: n. 目击者, 见证人

examples.en: An eyewitness described the accident to the police in detail.
examples.zh: 一名目击者向警察详细描述了事故经过。

meaning: n. 使人激动的东西, 使人毛骨悚然的东西, 使人毛骨悚然的小说

examples.en: I stayed up late finishing the detective thriller last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚我熬夜看完了那本侦探惊悚小说。

meaning: vt. 追求, 向...求爱, 恳求;vi. 求爱, 央求

examples.en: He brought flowers to woo the girl next door.
examples.zh: 他带着花去追求隔壁的女孩。

meaning: n. 毛织品;a. 羊毛制的

examples.en: Grandma knitted me a warm woollen scarf for winter.
examples.zh: 奶奶给我织了一条冬天戴的羊毛围巾。

meaning: n. 韵, 押韵, 韵文;vi. 押韵

examples.en: Children love this rhyme about a cat and a hat.
examples.zh: 孩子们喜欢这首关于猫和帽子的童谣。

meaning: n. 铲子, 锄, 铲刀, 黑桃;vt. 以锄掘, 把...弄实抹平

examples.en: He dug the hole with a spade before planting the tree.
examples.zh: 他用铁锹挖了个坑,然后种下树苗。

meaning: vt. 消遣, 娱乐, 使发笑

examples.en: The funny clown tried to amuse the crying child.
examples.zh: 滑稽的小丑努力逗那个哭闹的孩子开心。

meaning: a. 多汁液的, 生动的, 多水分的

examples.en: The watermelon we bought yesterday is sweet and juicy.
examples.zh: 我们昨天买的西瓜又甜又多汁。

meaning: vt. 污染, 弄脏, 玷污;污染

examples.en: Factories that pollute the river must pay heavy fines.
examples.zh: 污染河流的工厂必须缴纳巨额罚款。

meaning: n. 佛教徒;a. 佛教的

examples.en: The Buddhist temple attracts visitors from all over the country.
examples.zh: 这座佛教寺庙吸引着来自全国的游客。

meaning: a. 直言无讳的, 坦率的, 坦白无隐的

examples.en: She is outspoken and always says exactly what she thinks.
examples.zh: 她心直口快,总是怎么想就怎么说。

meaning: n. 海峡, 困境;a. 困难的, 窘迫的, 狭窄的

examples.en: The ship sailed slowly through the narrow strait at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明时分,轮船缓缓驶过狭窄的海峡。

meaning: a. 无价值的, 无益的, 无足轻重的;无价值的, 无用的

examples.en: The old coin turned out to be worthless, not rare.
examples.zh: 那枚旧硬币原来毫无价值,并不稀罕。

meaning: n. 可可粉, 可可茶, 可可色;可可, 可可豆

examples.en: She made hot cocoa for the kids after the snowstorm.
examples.zh: 暴风雪过后,她给孩子们煮了热可可。

meaning: n. 轶事, 奇闻

examples.en: Grandpa told a funny anecdote about his first day at school.
examples.zh: 爷爷讲了一件他上学第一天的趣事。

meaning: n. 小面包;血液尿素氮

examples.en: She ate a fresh bun and drank milk for breakfast.
examples.zh: 她早餐吃了一个新鲜的小圆面包,喝了牛奶。

meaning: a. 喘不过气来的, 屏气的, 气喘吁吁的, 无风的, 死的

examples.en: We arrived breathless after running up ten flights of stairs.
examples.zh: 跑上十段楼梯后,我们气喘吁吁地到了。

meaning: n. 冰岛

examples.en: Many tourists visit Iceland to see the northern lights.
examples.zh: 许多游客去冰岛看北极光。

meaning: vi. 行礼, 致意, 问候, 放礼炮;vt. 向...致意, 迎接, 赞扬

examples.en: The soldiers salute the flag every morning at sunrise.
examples.zh: 士兵们每天清晨日出时向国旗敬礼。

meaning: n. 邮筒, 邮箱;邮箱, 电子邮箱

examples.en: There were two letters waiting in the mailbox this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上信箱里有两封信等着取。

meaning: n. 箴言, 座右铭, 警句

examples.en: Our school motto reminds students to work hard and stay kind.
examples.zh: 我们的校训提醒学生勤奋学习、保持善良。

meaning: a. 芬香的, 馥郁的, 愉快的

examples.en: The fragrant flowers filled the whole garden with sweetness.
examples.zh: 芳香的花朵让整个花园充满甜香。

meaning: n. 一口, 满口

examples.en: He took a big mouthful of rice and started laughing.
examples.zh: 他夹了一大口米饭,然后就笑了起来。

meaning: n. 凤梨, 菠萝, 失业救济金;凤梨, 波萝

examples.en: She cut the pineapple into small pieces for the fruit salad.
examples.zh: 她把菠萝切成小块,用来做水果沙拉。

meaning: adv. 无论如何, 至少

examples.en: The tickets were expensive, but we enjoyed the show anyhow.
examples.zh: 票价很贵,但不管怎样我们还是很享受演出。

meaning: n. 茶碟, 茶托;碟

examples.en: The cat licked the milk from the small saucer.
examples.zh: 猫舔光了小碟子里的牛奶。

meaning: a. 不安全的, 不安稳的, 危险的;不安全

examples.en: The old bridge is unsafe, so walkers must use the tunnel.
examples.zh: 老桥不安全,行人必须走隧道。

meaning: n. 阿拉伯语;a. 阿拉伯语的, 阿拉伯人的, 阿拉伯式的

examples.en: She is learning Arabic because she wants to work in Dubai.
examples.zh: 她正在学阿拉伯语,因为想去迪拜工作。

meaning: n. 桨, 划桨, 明轮翼;vi. 划桨, 戏水, 涉水

examples.en: We used a wooden paddle to move the canoe forward.
examples.zh: 我们用木桨推动独木舟前进。

meaning: vt.vi. 给文章加标点, 加标点符号;vt. 强调, 加强, (常用被动)不时打断

examples.en: Remember to punctuate your sentences before handing in the composition.
examples.zh: 交作文前记得给句子加上标点。

meaning: a. 麻木的, 失去知觉的;vt. 使麻木, 使昏迷, 使失去知觉

examples.en: My fingers went numb after playing in the snow.
examples.zh: 在雪地里玩过之后,我的手指冻僵了。

meaning: n. 穆斯林;a. 穆斯林的, 伊斯兰教的

examples.en: Many Moslem families fast during the month of Ramadan.
examples.zh: 许多穆斯林家庭在斋月期间封斋。

meaning: a. 不重要的

examples.en: Do not waste time arguing about unimportant small details.
examples.zh: 别浪费时间争论不重要的细节。

meaning: a. 犯错的, 错误的;mistake的过去分词

examples.en: I was mistaken about the time; the meeting starts at noon.
examples.zh: 我搞错时间了,会议中午才开始。

meaning: a. 不适当的, 不胜任的, 不健康的;vt. 使不相宜, 使不合格

examples.en: He was unfit for military service because of his eyesight.
examples.zh: 他因为视力原因不适合服兵役。

meaning: a. 有毒的, 恶毒的, 讨厌的;有毒的

examples.en: Some poisonous mushrooms look exactly like safe ones.
examples.zh: 有些毒蘑菇长得和安全的几乎一模一样。

meaning: n. 腐烂, 腐蚀, 败坏;vi. 腐烂, 烂, 堕落, 憔悴

examples.en: The apples will rot quickly if you leave them in the sun.
examples.zh: 苹果放在太阳下很快就会腐烂。

meaning: n. 垃圾箱

examples.en: Please drop the empty bottles into the recycling dustbin.
examples.zh: 请把空瓶子扔进可回收垃圾桶。

meaning: a. 麻烦的, 令人讨厌的

examples.en: The troublesome printer keeps jamming every few minutes.
examples.zh: 这台烦人的打印机每隔几分钟就卡纸。

meaning: a. 无价值的, 徒然的, 空虚的, 自负的, 愚蠢的

examples.en: She spent hours styling her hair, but all in vain.
examples.zh: 她花了好几个小时做头发,但全是徒劳。

meaning: n. 浴缸

examples.en: The kids filled the bathtub with bubbles and warm water.
examples.zh: 孩子们往浴缸里放满了泡泡和温水。

meaning: n. 剩货, 残留物, 剩饭;a. 残余的

examples.en: We made soup from leftover vegetables in the fridge.
examples.zh: 我们用冰箱里剩下的蔬菜煮了汤。

meaning: a. 结实的；矮胖的；勇敢的；激烈的;n. 矮胖子；烈性啤酒

examples.en: A stout old man walked his dog around the square.
examples.zh: 一位矮胖的老人在广场上遛狗。

meaning: a. 无法忍受的, 承受不住的

examples.en: The summer heat became unbearable without a working fan.
examples.zh: 没有可用的风扇,夏日的酷热让人难以忍受。

meaning: a. 用旧的, 穿旧的;wear的过去分词

examples.en: His worn shoes told of many miles of walking.
examples.zh: 他那破旧的鞋子说明他走过很多路。

meaning: n. 瓜, 甜瓜, 红利, 赃物;三聚二氰亚胺

examples.en: We shared a sweet melon under the shade tree.
examples.zh: 我们在树荫下分吃了一个甜瓜。

meaning: n. 女主人, 女房东, 女老板

examples.en: The hostess welcomed every guest with a warm smile.
examples.zh: 女主人带着热情的微笑欢迎每一位客人。

meaning: n. 电报, 一封电报;电报

examples.en: A telegram arrived saying that Aunt Rose was safe.
examples.zh: 一封电报说萝丝阿姨平安无事。

meaning: a. 跛足的, 僵痛的, 不完全的, 金属薄板, 不知内情的人;vi. 变跛

examples.en: The lame dog limped slowly toward its food bowl.
examples.zh: 那条瘸腿的狗一瘸一拐地走向食盆。

meaning: a. 植物学的;n. 植物性药材

examples.en: Our class visited the botanical garden to study rare plants.
examples.zh: 我们班参观了植物园,观察珍稀植物。

meaning: n. 惊骇, 吃惊;惊吓

examples.en: The sudden knock at the door gave her a fright.
examples.zh: 突然的敲门声吓了她一大跳。

meaning: a. 衣衫褴褛的, 低劣的, 破旧的, 吝啬的, 卑鄙的

examples.en: He wore a shabby jacket that was full of patches.
examples.zh: 他穿着一件打满补丁的破旧夹克。

meaning: a. 无条件的, 无限制的, 绝对的;无条件的, 无保留的

examples.en: A mother's love for her child is unconditional and endless.
examples.zh: 母亲对孩子的爱是无条件且无尽的。

meaning: interj. 干杯, 再见

examples.en: The crowd rose to their feet with loud cheers.
examples.zh: 人群欢呼着站了起来。

meaning: n. 佛教

examples.en: He spent years studying Buddhism in a mountain temple.
examples.zh: 他在山间寺庙里修习了多年佛教。

meaning: n. 哈欠;vi. 打哈欠, 裂开

examples.en: The tired students began to yawn during the long lecture.
examples.zh: 漫长的讲座中,疲惫的学生们开始打哈欠。

meaning: n. 茄子

examples.en: Grandma cooked eggplant with garlic for tonight's dinner.
examples.zh: 奶奶用大蒜烧茄子,当作今晚的晚餐。

meaning: n. 雷暴雨

examples.en: The thunderstorm delayed our flight by nearly three hours.
examples.zh: 雷暴使我们的航班延误了近三个小时。

meaning: n. 金鱼

examples.en: My little sister feeds the goldfish every morning.
examples.zh: 我妹妹每天早上都喂金鱼。

meaning: a. 南极的, 南极地带的;n. 南极地区

examples.en: Scientists live in the Antarctic to study its unique wildlife.
examples.zh: 科学家们住在南极洲,研究那里独特的野生动物。

meaning: n. 口渴, 渴望;vi. 口渴, 渴望

examples.en: The long hike in the sun left us with terrible thirst.
examples.zh: 烈日下长途徒步让我们口渴难耐。

meaning: n. 中小学的校长

examples.en: Our headteacher praised the class for winning the competition.
examples.zh: 校长表扬了我们班赢得比赛。

meaning: a. 不真实的, 不正确的, 不忠实的;虚伪的, 不真实的, 不正确的

examples.en: The rumor about the school closing proved completely untrue.
examples.zh: 学校要关闭的谣言被证实完全不实。

meaning: vt. 重新寄送, 使改道, 使改方向;重定向, 重新引导

examples.en: The system will redirect you to a new login page.
examples.zh: 系统会将你重新引导到新的登录页面。

meaning: n. 诞生地

examples.en: Tourists visit the poet's small birthplace in the countryside.
examples.zh: 游客们参观诗人在乡下的出生地。

meaning: n. 公鸡, 栖息的鸟;炉篦

examples.en: The rooster woke the whole farm before sunrise.
examples.zh: 天亮前,公鸡就叫醒了整个农场。

meaning: n. 枪乌贼, 鱿鱼, 反潜水雷发射装置;超导量子干涉元件

examples.en: The fishermen caught a huge squid off the coast.
examples.zh: 渔民们在近海捕获了一只巨大的鱿鱼。

meaning: adv. 向北方

examples.en: The birds fly northwards when spring returns each year.
examples.zh: 每年春天来临,鸟儿们就向北飞去。

meaning: n. 勇敢

examples.en: The firefighter received a medal for his bravery in the rescue.
examples.zh: 消防员因救援中的勇敢表现获得了奖章。

meaning: n. 牛

examples.en: The farmer used an ox to plow the wet field.
examples.zh: 农夫用一头牛犁那块湿地。

meaning: n. 手足情谊, 兄弟关系

examples.en: The team played with a spirit of true brotherhood.
examples.zh: 这支球队怀着真正的兄弟情谊打球。

meaning: a. 发臭的, 有臭味的

examples.en: Take off those smelly socks and put them in the wash.
examples.zh: 快脱下那些臭袜子,放进要洗的衣服里。

meaning: n. 食品商

examples.en: The grocer sells fresh fruit at the street corner.
examples.zh: 街角的杂货商贩卖新鲜水果。

meaning: vt. 摇摆, 摇动, 饶舌;vi. 摆动, 喋喋不休

examples.en: Dogs wag their tails when they feel happy.
examples.zh: 狗开心的时候会摇尾巴。

meaning: n. 粥, 糊

examples.en: A hot bowl of porridge keeps us warm on winter mornings.
examples.zh: 冬天的早晨,一碗热粥让我们暖暖的。

meaning: n. 宾戈(一种赌博游戏), 烈酒

examples.en: Grandma won three games of bingo at the community center.
examples.zh: 奶奶在社区中心赢了三局宾果游戏。

meaning: n. 战场, 战地

examples.en: The old battleground is now a quiet memorial park.
examples.zh: 昔日的战场如今是安静的纪念公园。

meaning: a. 弯曲的, 决心的;n. 爱好

examples.en: The strong wind bent the young trees nearly to the ground.
examples.zh: 大风把小树几乎吹弯到了地面。

meaning: n. 酸乳, 酸奶

examples.en: She mixed fresh berries into her breakfast yoghurt.
examples.zh: 她把新鲜浆果拌进了早餐的酸奶里。

meaning: a. 熟练的, 巧妙的;熟练的

examples.en: The skillful carpenter fixed the broken chair in ten minutes.
examples.zh: 手艺娴熟的木匠十分钟就修好了坏椅子。

meaning: a. 多山的, 如山的, 巨大的

examples.en: They live in a mountainous region with few modern roads.
examples.zh: 他们住在很少有现代公路的山区。

meaning: n. 茶壶

examples.en: Grandma poured hot tea from her favorite blue teapot.
examples.zh: 奶奶用她心爱的蓝茶壶倒热茶。

meaning: n. 木柴

examples.en: The children helped their father gather firewood for the winter.
examples.zh: 孩子们帮父亲为过冬收集木柴。

meaning: n. 书架, 书柜

examples.en: Dad built a wooden bookcase for my growing collection.
examples.zh: 爸爸为我越来越多的藏书做了一个木书架。

meaning: vt. 使惊讶

examples.en: Her sudden improvement in math managed to astonish everyone.
examples.zh: 她数学的突飞猛进让所有人都很吃惊。

meaning: n. 小牛肉;vt. 宰小牛

examples.en: The restaurant is famous for its tender veal dishes.
examples.zh: 这家餐厅以鲜嫩的小牛肉菜肴闻名。

meaning: adv. 吵闹地

examples.en: The students left the classroom noisily after the final bell.
examples.zh: 终场铃响后,学生们吵吵闹闹地离开了教室。

meaning: a. 燃烧的, 热烈的, 色彩鲜明的

examples.en: The flaming autumn leaves covered the hills in bright red.
examples.zh: 火红的秋叶把群山染成了明亮的红色。

meaning: n. (中小学)女校长

examples.en: The headmistress gave an inspiring speech at the opening ceremony.
examples.zh: 女校长在开学典礼上发表了鼓舞人心的讲话。

meaning: n. 扩音器, 喇叭;扬声器

examples.en: An announcement over the loudspeaker asked us to board the train.
examples.zh: 扩音器里的广播通知我们上车。

meaning: n. 海草, 海藻;海藻

examples.en: The beach was covered with seaweed after the storm.
examples.zh: 风暴过后,海滩上铺满了海草。

meaning: n. 南极洲

examples.en: Very few plants can survive the extreme cold of Antarctica.
examples.zh: 极少的植物能在南极洲的极寒中存活。

meaning: n. 浴衣

examples.en: He answered the door in a warm bathrobe on Sunday morning.
examples.zh: 周日早晨,他穿着暖和的浴袍去开门。

meaning: n. 雪球, 果味冰霜卷, 滚雪球式的募捐法;vt. 向...丢雪球, 使滚雪球般增长

examples.en: My brother's snowball hit the tree instead of me.
examples.zh: 弟弟的雪球打中了树,而没有打中我。

meaning: n. 早午餐

examples.en: We enjoyed a late brunch of pancakes and fresh juice.
examples.zh: 我们享用了一顿有煎饼和鲜榨果汁的晚早午餐。

meaning: n. 玩伴, 游伴

examples.en: The little girl found a new playmate at the playground.
examples.zh: 小女孩在游乐场找到了一个新玩伴。

meaning: adv. 向西

examples.en: The settlers traveled westwards in search of better farmland.
examples.zh: 拓荒者们向西而行,寻找更肥沃的农田。

meaning: vt. 使成熟;vi. 成熟

examples.en: The tomatoes will ripen fully in another warm week.
examples.zh: 再经历一个暖和的星期,番茄就会完全成熟。

meaning: adv. 向东方地

examples.en: The plane flew eastwards toward the rising morning sun.
examples.zh: 飞机朝着初升的朝阳向东飞去。

meaning: n. 打字员

examples.en: She works as a fast and accurate typist in a law firm.
examples.zh: 她在律师事务所当打字员,又快又准。

meaning: a. 间接获得的, 旧的, 二手的, 做旧货买卖的;adv. 间接地, 间接听来, 以旧货

examples.en: I bought a secondhand bicycle for just twenty dollars.
examples.zh: 我只花二十美元买了一辆二手自行车。

meaning: interj. 哎唷(表剧痛);n. 扣环, 胸针, 珠宝饰物

examples.en: Ouch! I just stepped on a sharp piece of glass.
examples.zh: 哎哟!我踩到了一块锋利的玻璃。

meaning: a. 多丘陵的, 多山岗的, 险峻的

examples.en: The hilly road makes cycling to town quite tiring.
examples.zh: 高低起伏的坡路使骑车进城很累人。

meaning: n. 划船

examples.en: We went boating on the lake every summer weekend.
examples.zh: 每个夏天的周末,我们都去湖上划船。

meaning: n. 蝗虫, 蚱蜢, 蝉

examples.en: The locust is an insect that can destroy entire crops.
examples.zh: 蝗虫是一种能毁掉整片庄稼的昆虫。

meaning: n. 羊肉

examples.en: Grandpa loves mutton stew with potatoes and carrots.
examples.zh: 爷爷最爱土豆胡萝卜炖羊肉。

meaning: v. 违反, 不服从

examples.en: Soldiers must never disobey orders during a dangerous mission.
examples.zh: 在危险任务中,士兵绝不能违抗命令。

meaning: n. 中客车, 小型公共汽车

examples.en: Our class hired a minibus for the trip to the museum.
examples.zh: 我们班租了一辆小巴去博物馆参观。

meaning: n. 煎蛋卷, 炒蛋

examples.en: Mom made a cheese omelette for my birthday breakfast.
examples.zh: 妈妈为我的生日早餐做了奶酪煎蛋饼。

meaning: n. 女主席, 女议长

examples.en: The chairwoman opened the meeting with a short welcome speech.
examples.zh: 女主席以简短的欢迎词宣布会议开始。

meaning: a. 无绳索的, 交直流两用的

examples.en: He used a cordless drill to hang the picture frame.
examples.zh: 他用无绳电钻挂上了相框。

meaning: n. 上海, 浦东鸡;a. 上海的, 上海时行的, 上海风格的

examples.en: My parents first met in Shanghai almost thirty years ago.
examples.zh: 我父母大约三十年前在上海初次相遇。

meaning: n. 植物学;植物学

examples.en: Her interest in botany grew from tending her small garden.
examples.zh: 她对植物学的兴趣源于打理自己的小花园。

meaning: n. 西藏

examples.en: They rode the famous railway to Tibet last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天,他们乘着著名的铁路去了西藏。

meaning: n. 生物化学;生物化学; 生化

examples.en: She is doing research in biochemistry at the university lab.
examples.zh: 她在大学实验室从事生物化学研究。

meaning: n. 空域, 空间;气隙

examples.en: The small plane accidentally entered restricted airspace near the airport.
examples.zh: 小飞机意外闯入了机场附近的禁飞空域。

meaning: vt. 灌溉, 冲洗伤口, 使清新;vi. 灌溉

examples.en: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the nearby river.
examples.zh: 农民们用附近河里的水灌溉田地。

meaning: n. 新郎

examples.en: The bridegroom smiled nervously as the wedding began.
examples.zh: 婚礼开始时,新郎紧张地微笑着。

meaning: n. 领带

examples.en: Dad straightened his necktie before walking into the interview room.
examples.zh: 爸爸走进面试房间前,先整了整领带。

meaning: n. 空中小姐, 女管理人, 女管家

examples.en: The stewardess showed us how to fasten our seat belts.
examples.zh: 空姐向我们示范如何系好安全带。

meaning: n. 热水瓶

examples.en: She filled the thermos with hot tea for the road trip.
examples.zh: 她往保温瓶里灌满了热茶,以备路上喝。

meaning: n. 路旁;a. 路旁的

examples.en: Wild flowers grew along the wayside as we climbed.
examples.zh: 我们爬山时,野花在路边竞相开放。

meaning: a. 仁慈的, 慈悲的

examples.en: The merciful king freed all the prisoners that spring.
examples.zh: 仁慈的国王在那年春天释放了所有囚犯。

meaning: a. 没味道的, 无鉴赏力的

examples.en: The soup was tasteless until Mom added a little salt.
examples.zh: 汤原本淡而无味,直到妈妈加了点盐。

meaning: n. 蜂窝, 蜂箱;集气架, 蜂巢

examples.en: Bees flew busily in and out of the wooden beehive.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在木蜂箱边忙碌地飞进飞出。

meaning: a. 美味的, 可口的, 赏心悦目的, 愉快的

examples.en: The freshly baked cookies smell so yummy that I want one.
examples.zh: 刚出炉的饼干闻起来太香了,我都想吃了。

meaning: n. 防风林, 防风茄克衫, 风衣

examples.en: He zipped up his windbreaker against the cold sea breeze.
examples.zh: 他拉上防风夹克的拉链,抵御寒冷的海风。

meaning: adv. 注意地, 留心地

examples.en: The students listened attentively while the teacher explained the poem.
examples.zh: 老师讲解诗歌时,学生们都专心地听着。

meaning: a. 苦干的, 不辞辛劳的

examples.en: The hardworking farmer starts his day before the sun rises.
examples.zh: 勤劳的农夫在太阳升起前就开始劳作。

meaning: n. 同窗, 同学

examples.en: An old schoolmate of mine is now a famous doctor.
examples.zh: 我的一位老同学如今成了著名的医生。

meaning: n. 半圆形

examples.en: The children sat in a semicircle around the storyteller.
examples.zh: 孩子们围着讲故事的人坐成半圆。

meaning: n. 气象员；天气预报员

examples.en: The weatherman said rain would arrive by evening.
examples.zh: 气象员说傍晚会下雨。

meaning: n. 商人, 办理实务的人, 经商者

examples.en: The successful businesswoman flies to meetings around the world.
examples.zh: 这位成功的女商人飞往世界各地开会。

meaning: a. 未分开的, 专一的, (组织等)未分裂的;不可分割的, 完整的, 未分割的

examples.en: Please give me your undivided attention for five minutes.
examples.zh: 请给我五分钟全神贯注的时间。

meaning: n. 海贝壳

examples.en: She picked up a pink seashell on the beach.
examples.zh: 她在海滩上捡到了一个粉色的贝壳。

meaning: n. 过冬, 冬眠, 避寒;冬眠, 冬蛰

examples.en: Bears eat a lot before going into hibernation for winter.
examples.zh: 熊在进入冬眠之前会吃很多东西。

meaning: n. 干燥机, 干燥剂;干燥剂; 催干剂; 干燥设备; 干燥器; 烘缸

examples.en: The drier is broken, so we must hang the clothes outside.
examples.zh: 烘干机坏了,我们只能把衣服晾在外面。

meaning: n. 具有超人能力的人, 超人

examples.en: My little brother dressed as superman for the costume party.
examples.zh: 我弟弟打扮成超人去参加化装舞会。

meaning: vt. 重绕;n. 重绕

examples.en: Rewind the tape if you want to hear that song again.
examples.zh: 如果想再听那首歌,就把磁带倒回去。

meaning: n. 超短裙

examples.en: She bought a fashionable miniskirt for the summer party.
examples.zh: 她为夏日聚会买了一条时髦的迷你裙。

meaning: n. 游戏室, 娱乐室

examples.en: The kids tidied the playroom before their guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人到来之前,孩子们把游戏室收拾好了。

meaning: n. 听写, 口述, 命令

examples.en: The teacher gave us a short dictation every Friday morning.
examples.zh: 老师每周五早上都给我们做一次短听写。

meaning: n. 女售货员, 女店员

examples.en: The saleswoman helped me choose a gift for my mother.
examples.zh: 女售货员帮我挑选送给母亲的礼物。

meaning: n. 计时表, 码表

examples.en: The coach used a stopwatch to time each runner.
examples.zh: 教练用秒表给每位跑步者计时。

meaning: n. 书签;书签

examples.en: I use a train ticket as a bookmark in my novel.
examples.zh: 我用一张火车票当小说的书签。

meaning: n. 渥太华

examples.en: My aunt moved to Ottawa after finishing her degree in Canada.
examples.zh: 我姑姑在加拿大完成学业后,搬到了渥太华。

meaning: interj. 万岁;n. 万岁

examples.en: Hooray! Our team scored the winning goal in the last minute.
examples.zh: 太好了!我们队在最后一分钟进了制胜一球。

meaning: n. 台风

examples.en: The typhoon forced the school to close for two days.
examples.zh: 台风迫使学校停课两天。

meaning: n. 温室, 玻璃工场, 禁闭房

examples.en: Tomatoes grow faster inside the warm glasshouse in early spring.
examples.zh: 早春时节,番茄在温暖的温室里长得更快。

meaning: n. 背痛

examples.en: Lifting heavy boxes wrongly gave him a terrible backache.
examples.zh: 搬重箱子的姿势不对,让他的腰疼得厉害。

meaning: n. 祝贺, 恭喜

examples.en: She sent a letter of congratulation to the winning team.
examples.zh: 她给获胜的队伍发了一封祝贺信。

meaning: n. 祖国

examples.en: He returned to his motherland after living abroad for decades.
examples.zh: 在国外生活几十年后,他回到了祖国。

meaning: a. 沉溺于...的, 无法摆脱(某种嗜好)的;嗜, 好, 惯于

examples.en: He is addicted to video games and plays every night.
examples.zh: 他迷上了电子游戏,每天晚上都玩。

meaning: n. 盥洗室

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the nearest washroom in this building?
examples.zh: 打扰一下,这栋楼里最近的洗手间在哪里?

meaning: n. 修面的人, 电动剃刀, 刨刀, 杀价买进期票的人, 善于讨价还价的人

examples.en: Dad keeps an electric shaver in his travel bag.
examples.zh: 爸爸的旅行包里放着一把电动剃须刀。

meaning: n. 稀粥;vt. 使极度疲劳, 惩罚

examples.en: In the old story, the poor boy ate thin gruel daily.
examples.zh: 在老故事里,那个穷孩子每天喝稀粥。

meaning: n. 油田

examples.en: Many workers moved to the city after the oilfield closed down.
examples.zh: 油田关闭之后,许多工人搬进了城里。

meaning: a. 百分度的, 摄氏的;百分度

examples.en: Water freezes at zero degrees centigrade under normal conditions.
examples.zh: 在正常条件下,水在零摄氏度结冰。

meaning: n. 电视电话

examples.en: Grandma uses the videophone to see us every Sunday evening.
examples.zh: 奶奶每周日晚上都用可视电话和我们见面。

meaning: n. 航空邮件

examples.en: She sent the birthday card by airmail from London.
examples.zh: 她从伦敦用航空邮件寄出了生日贺卡。

meaning: n. 研磨者, 卷笔刀, 研磨工具

examples.en: May I borrow your pencil sharpener for a moment?
examples.zh: 我可以借用一下你的卷笔刀吗?

meaning: n. 女店员

examples.en: The friendly salesgirl wrapped the present in pretty paper.
examples.zh: 友好的女售货员用漂亮的纸把礼物包好。

meaning: n. 镭;镭Ra

examples.en: Marie Curie discovered the element radium through years of research.
examples.zh: 居里夫人经过多年研究发现了镭元素。

meaning: a. 晒黑的, 有晒斑的, 日炙的

examples.en: His sunburnt shoulders hurt after a day at the beach.
examples.zh: 在海滩晒了一天后,他晒伤的肩膀很疼。

meaning: 跳跃

examples.en: The girls enjoyed skipping rope in the school yard.
examples.zh: 女孩们喜欢在学校院子里跳绳。

meaning: n. 大洋洲

examples.en: Oceania includes Australia and many small islands in the Pacific.
examples.zh: 大洋洲包括澳大利亚和太平洋上的许多小岛。

meaning: be的现在时复数或第二人称单数

examples.en: There are many apples in the basket on the table.
examples.zh: 桌上的篮子里有很多苹果。

meaning: n. 豆腐

examples.en: Mapo beancurd is my favorite dish at the Sichuan restaurant.
examples.zh: 麻婆豆腐是我在川菜馆最爱点的菜。

meaning: n. 铺盖, 床上用品;铺盖, 被褥

examples.en: Mom washed all the bedclothes on that sunny morning.
examples.zh: 那个晴朗的早晨,妈妈把所有床品都洗了。

meaning: n. 寝具；（建筑） 基床；（家畜）草垫;a. 适于花坛种植的

examples.en: The camp provides simple beddings for every guest.
examples.zh: 营地为每位客人提供简单的床上用品。

meaning: n. 炸土豆条；小木片；（作赌注用的）圆形筹码；缺口（chip的复数形式）

examples.en: He ordered fish and chips at the seaside cafe.
examples.zh: 他在海边小餐馆点了炸鱼薯条。

meaning: v. 做；工作；有用（do的第三人称单数形式）

examples.en: She does her homework right after dinner every day.
examples.zh: 她每天一吃完晚饭就做作业。

meaning: n. 手推车,手推运货车

examples.en: The mover used a handtruck to carry the heavy boxes.
examples.zh: 搬运工用手推车来搬运沉重的箱子。

meaning: a. 最近的

examples.en: Have you read the latest book by that famous author?
examples.zh: 你读过那位著名作家的最新作品吗?

meaning: n. 大量, 众多; 二十( score的名词复数 ); （游戏或比赛中的）得分; 大量; 百分数

examples.en: He got high scores in both math and English exams.
examples.zh: 他在数学和英语考试中都得了高分。

meaning: n. 小路, 人行道, 旁路

examples.en: The cat slipped sideways off the wet garden wall.
examples.zh: 那只猫从湿漉漉的花园墙上滑向了一边。

meaning: n. 纪念品( souvenir的名词复数 )

examples.en: We bought some souvenirs at the gift shop before leaving.
examples.zh: 离开前,我们在礼品店买了一些纪念品。

meaning: n. 家伙, 支索;vt. 用支索撑住, 取笑, 嘲弄

examples.en: That guy in the red hat helped me find my wallet.
examples.zh: 那个戴红帽子的家伙帮我找到了钱包。

meaning: n. 经营, 支配, 管理;管理处

examples.en: The hotel management apologized for the noise during our stay.
examples.zh: 酒店管理层为住宿期间的噪音向我们道歉。

meaning: n. 军队;a. 军事的, 军人的, 适于战争的

examples.en: He spent two years doing military service after college.
examples.zh: 大学毕业后,他服了两年兵役。

meaning: n. 位置, 场所, 地点;vt. 给...择址

examples.en: The construction site is closed to visitors on weekends.
examples.zh: 建筑工地周末不对参观者开放。

meaning: n. 影像, 肖像, 想象, 图像, 形象, 翻版;vt. 作...的像, 反映, 想象, 象征

examples.en: The image on the screen suddenly went completely black.
examples.zh: 屏幕上的画面突然完全变黑了。

meaning: n. 方案, 计划, 组合, 系统, 图解, 诡计, 阴谋;v. 计划, 设计, 图谋, 策划

examples.en: The city has a new scheme for recycling household waste.
examples.zh: 市里推出了一项家庭垃圾回收的新计划。

meaning: n. 共和主义者, 共和党员;a. 共和政体的, 共和国的, 共和主义的

examples.en: Her uncle is a loyal republican who never misses an election.
examples.zh: 她叔叔是忠诚的共和党人,从不缺席选举。

meaning: n. 统治者, 阁下, 上帝;vi. 称王, 作威作福

examples.en: The lord of the castle welcomed us with a grand dinner.
examples.zh: 城堡领主设下盛大的晚宴欢迎我们。

meaning: n. 行为, 举止;行为

examples.en: The teacher praised the class for their excellent behavior.
examples.zh: 老师表扬了全班同学的良好表现。

meaning: a. 更远的, 此外的, 更多的;vt. 促进, 增进, 助长

examples.en: We need further information before making the final decision.
examples.zh: 在做最终决定之前,我们需要进一步的信息。

meaning: vt. 确定, 保证, 担保, 保护;确保, 确定

examples.en: Please check the list twice to ensure nothing is missing.
examples.zh: 请把清单核对两遍,确保没有遗漏。

meaning: n. 反应, 回答, 响应;应答

examples.en: We received a quick response to our email inquiry.
examples.zh: 我们的邮件询问很快就得到了回复。

meaning: n. 面孔的一部分(如眼、口等), 特征, 容貌, 特色, 特写;vt. 是...的特色, 特写, 放映

examples.en: The best feature of this phone is its battery life.
examples.zh: 这部手机最出色的特点是电池续航。

meaning: n. (政府提供的)钱和设备, 准备, 供应品, 规定, 条款;vt. 供给...食物及必需品

examples.en: The provision of clean water remains a challenge in remote villages.
examples.zh: 提供清洁用水在偏远村庄仍是难题。

meaning: n. 县, 郡

examples.en: They live in a small county famous for its apples.
examples.zh: 他们住在以苹果闻名的小县。

meaning: n. 法国

examples.en: We spent two lovely weeks in France last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天,我们在法国度过了愉快的两周。

meaning: n. 最佳部分, 初期, 全盛期;a. 主要的, 最初的, 根本的

examples.en: The prime minister answered questions from reporters this morning.
examples.zh: 首相今天上午回答了记者的提问。

meaning: n. 元件, 元素, 要素;部分; 成分; 单元; 码元; 元件; 元素; 单元

examples.en: Honesty is a key element of any strong friendship.
examples.zh: 诚实是任何牢固友谊的关键要素。

meaning: n. 战略, 策略;战略, 策略

examples.en: The coach explained his strategy during the short break.
examples.zh: 教练在短暂休息时讲解了他的战术。

meaning: n. 代表会议, 苏维埃, 苏联;a. 苏维埃的, 苏联的

examples.en: My history teacher lived in the Soviet Union as a child.
examples.zh: 我的历史老师小时候生活在苏联。

meaning: a. 最初的, 原始的, 有创意的;n. 原物, 原作

examples.en: The original painting hangs in a museum in Paris.
examples.zh: 那幅原作挂在巴黎的一家博物馆里。

meaning: a. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好;adv. 好, 可以, 行, 对, 好吗, 很好

examples.en: It is okay to make mistakes while learning a language.
examples.zh: 学语言的时候,犯点错误没关系。

meaning: n. 范围, 程度, 区域;范围

examples.en: To some extent, the weather decided the outcome of the game.
examples.zh: 在某种程度上,天气决定了比赛的结果。

meaning: vt. 使能够;允许, 使能, 打开

examples.en: The new bridge will enable villagers to reach town quickly.
examples.zh: 新桥将使村民们能快速到达镇上。

meaning: n. 原料, 要素, 东西, 材料, 素质, 织品, 废物, 废话;vt. 装填

examples.en: Dad keeps his fishing stuff in the garage.
examples.zh: 爸爸把钓鱼的家伙什都放在车库里。
